I replied to Gideon in the thread on #inc-vtg-hartford. Here is the answer.

- **First report:** Gideon first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (UTC-5). He said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **The guard:** In that same 10:42 message he said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Nothing else in the channel describes the guard until 11:03 AM, when Mateo said kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836. Gideon posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
- **Gap:** The channel doesn't say exactly when the guard started or stopped using the clipboard. I told Gideon that too.
